what: the fixture set the golden harness measures the rewrite against, and what each volume in it is a fixture of

registry.read: the application's own library, folded newest-per-slug exactly as internal/bundle.Registry folds it
registry.note: the library holds many builds per volume; the fixture is the build that would serve, and its stamp is recorded here so a re-capture that picks a different build is visible immediately

volumes.title: TUNIC
volumes.verifiedBy: one world, one lens, one pyramid, no merge beyond its own origin account and no split sheet: the simplest shape the pipeline writes, and the fixture a change to composition breaks first.

volumes.title: Cyberpunk 2077
volumes.verifiedBy: the world payload's merge ledger names Piggyback as the origin and IGN Wiki as a donor, with 270 matched pairs, 37 added and 61 held; its second lens is an aligned resample of the donor's raster. Verified against the ledger, not assumed.

volumes.title: Fallout: New Vegas
volumes.verifiedBy: thirteen worlds, eight of them insets carrying parent=mojave-wasteland: the sheet-splitting path, and the only fixture where a volume's worlds sort by family rather than by title.

volumes.title: Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
volumes.verifiedBy: one world with three lenses carrying shards 1783, 1784 and 1785 -- the sky, surface and depths of one ground, offered one at a time. The candidates first proposed for this slot (ghost-of-tsushima, sonic-frontiers, marathon) carry no shard on any lens; this is the only sharded volume in the library.

volumes.title: Mars
volumes.verifiedBy: the one volume declaring atlas.geometry.surface=sphere, with an equirectangular mapping and two lenses over one ground (Viking MDIM and MOLA elevation). Every pin carries true planetary coordinates.

withheld.classification: city: basemap lens, curated municipal layers, and the national hydrography enrichment with HUC12 membership
withheld.whyWithheld: the only city curated on the capturing machine is registered from internal/arcgismap/cities_local.go, which git ignores on purpose: it is a personal location. Its fixtures are written to golden/fixtures/private, which git also ignores, and its name appears in no committed file. Re-capture the city fixture from a publicly curated city -- bend-or or redondo-beach-ca -- once a bundle for one exists, and commit it then.
withheld.consequence: no committed fixture exercises path or area collections, inline geometry, label policy, standard-icon resolution by convention, or the >100% DescribedPct defect. golden/fixtures/measure/NOTES.md records what the withheld fixture shows.

translators.aligned: one archived capture per source, chosen to be the capture the fixture volumes were composed from

skipped.reason: the archived capture is present, but arcgismap.Translate refuses a city it is not curated for, and the only curated city on this machine is the withheld one. The fixture is capturable only where cities_local.go is present, and its output would be withheld for the same reason as the city bundle.

measure.verbatim: measure/maturity.txt, the report tools/maturity prints over a registry holding exactly the committed fixture set
measure.structured: measure/<slug>.build.json, internal/measure's own Build with the figures the reports derive from it
measure.defects: measure/NOTES.md -- annotated there, never corrected in the output

http.recorded: the headless application (ATLAS_HEADLESS=1) serving a registry holding exactly the committed fixture set
normalized: the catalog's bundlesDir, which is where this machine keeps its library
